Common Types of Real Estate Investment Loans in Parkland

Besides traditional hard money loans, investors in Parkland utilize various financing options. Fix and flip loans are the most common—covering purchase and rehab costs, with short repayment periods. These are ideal for quick turnaround projects.

Construction loans are another option for larger developments or new builds, offering funds based on project milestones. They tend to have more complex approval processes but are suitable for substantial investments.

Bridge loans are used when investors need quick cash to cover short-term gaps before securing long-term financing. Their flexible terms make them popular in competitive markets like Parkland.

Portfolio loans, though less common, allow investors to bundle multiple properties under one loan, simplifying management and potentially reducing costs. These are suited for investors with multiple holdings in Parkland.

Each loan type has its pros and cons. Selecting the right one depends on your project scope, investment timeline, and financial goals—our team can help guide you in choosing the best fit.
